messages:
ops-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: Spike in 5xx from edge-proxy-eu-1. Rate of TLS handshake errors (SSL/TLS) up ~12% over baseline. Grafana: https://grafana.redwood/projects/edge/handshake-spike (check 'client_hello_failures').

ops-bot: Summary: region=eu, service=edge-proxy, symptom=TLS handshake failures -> gateway 502/524/timeouts. Affected routes: /v1/generate (hosted api), webhooks.

sasha: on it. paging team. mike_o can you grab tcpdump on edge-proxy-eu-1? jen_prod please start customer-impact thread.

mike_o: grabbing pcap now. running: sudo tcpdump -i eth0 -w /tmp/edge-eu-handshake.pcap 'tcp port 443' (will upload).

mike_o: quick grep of logs shows repeated: "tls: client hello received, but no certificates match" and some "unknown_ca" alerts. also lots of: 
```
TLS handshake error: tls: unsupported protocol or cipher suite | client=10.23.5.44 | version=0x0303 | cipher=0x0000
```

jen_prod: CS notified top 10 customers on playbook list. emily_cs is coordinating customer comms. current estimate: ~3-5% of total requests failing, spike concentrated in eu-west and eu-central.

kevin_sre: checking cert rotator. I see a scheduled cert rotation job ran ~1h ago for the edge cert chain (rotator v2 -> v3). rotation logs: "rotator: uploaded new chain, cert_id=crt-9923, applied to pool but rollout_failed_on_10% due to handshake errors".

sasha: that aligns. suspect bad chain or missing intermediate (clients get client_hello mismatch). mike_o can you do a quick curl from a node to the upstream: 
```
curl -vsI https://edge.example.com/v1/health --resolve "edge.example.com:443:10.23.5.44"
```

mike_o: curl output shows: 
```
* Connected to edge.example.com (10.23.5.44) port 443 (#0)
* error:14094410:SSL routines:ssl3_read_bytes:tlsv1 alert unknown ca
* Closing connection 0
```

mike_o: tcpdump shows client_hello then immediate alert from server: "unknown_ca". looks like server rejecting client certs? but these are TLS mutual off for public API.

kevin_sre: rotator logs show chain uploaded missing intermediate CA 2 (chain length 2 instead of 3). some clients validate full path and fail. others pass due to cached chain. rollout likely exposed this.

jen_prod: Customer impact: hosted API (public) 2.8% errors, webhook deliveries failing at ~6% for EU customers. CS flagged customers: AcmeCorp, Finlytics, MedFlow. Emily drafting message: "We are investigating intermittent TLS errors in EU region; requests are intermittently failing with handshake errors. No data loss expected."

sasha: mitigation plan: 1) pause cert rotator rollout (kevin) 2) revert to previous cert chain on edge-proxy-eu-1 (kevin + ops) 3) add temporary traffic steering to other regions for non-EU traffic (mike) 4) monitor and update CS. any security risk with rollback?

kevin_sre: pausing rotator now. command: `rotatorctl pause --job cert-rotation-eu-2026-03` -> success. rolling back edge-proxy-eu-1 to cert_id=crt-8812 (previous stable). running `nginx -s reload` after chain replacement.

mike_o: rolled back chain on eu-1 and eu-2, reloaded nginx. giving 30s for LB health checks.

ops-bot: Incident note: mitigation step executed: rotator paused, chain rollback initiated. Please monitor.

mike_o: healthchecks green on eu-1 and eu-2. error rate dropping in last 90s from 12% -> 1.5%.

jen_prod: receiving initial CS confirmations: AcmeCorp webhook retries succeeding after 3 attempts. Emily sending update to customers: new status at 15:48 UTC.

sasha: good. next steps: 1) run full audit of rotated chain artifacts and rotator verification logic. 2) add pre-rollout fast smoke that verifies full chain on a subset of endpoints. 3) long-term: make rotator verify intermediate chain length and run client simulation tests.

kevin_sre: digging into why rotator accepted incomplete bundle. appears a packaging bug in rotator v2: when intermediate certificate file missing, it concatenates only leaf+root and marks success. patch incoming. creating PR: https://github.com/redwood/rotator/pull/432

mike_o: will leave traffic steering in fallback mode for 10 more minutes then gradually resume normal routing once error <0.5% for 10m.

jen_prod: on-call handoff: sasha -> jen_prod at 16:00UTC. jen will take ownership for postmortem and customer comms.

pagerduty-bot: On-call handover scheduled: jen_prod will be primary at 16:00 UTC.

emily_cs: sending follow-up to customers with mitigation summary and ETA for postmortem.

ops-bot: Incident resolved: error rate back to baseline (<0.2%). Keep incident open for RCA/drive-by for 24h.

jen_prod: marking impact: partial outage (EU TLS handshake failures) affecting 3-5% traffic for ~45 minutes. Postmortem owner: jen_prod. RCA: incomplete cert chain deployed by rotator v2. Action items: hotfix rotator + add chain verification smoke + improve rollout canary.

sasha: thanks team. leaving final notes in ops-incidents doc and will add extracted logs and pcap to S3: s3://redwood-incident-artifacts/1832105678/

kevin_sre: PR merged with hotfix, will schedule controlled redeploy of rotator after smoke tests.

jen_prod: closing the incident thread in 1h if no regressions. thanks all. :cheers:
